# waldur_identity_bridge_link (Resource)

Identity Bridge Link resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) ISD source identifier (must match `^[a-z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`)
- `username` (String) CUID / username of the federated user

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address
- `affiliations` (List of String) List of affiliations
- `birth_date` (String) Birth date
- `civil_number` (String) Civil number
- `country_of_residence` (String) Country of residence
- `eduperson_assurance` (List of String) List of eduperson assurances
- `email` (String) Email address
- `first_name` (String) First name
- `gender` (String) Gender
- `identity_source` (String) Identity source
- `last_name` (String) Last name
- `nationalities` (List of String) List of nationalities
- `nationality` (String) Nationality
- `organization` (String) Organization name
- `organization_country` (String) Organization country
- `organization_type` (String) Organization type
- `personal_title` (String) Personal title
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number
- `place_of_birth` (String) Place of birth
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identity Bridge Link UUID (used as Terraform ID)
